commands.deploy_web: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter web exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=finance-dashboard --branch=main
commands.deploy: pnpm --filter worker exec wrangler deploy && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter web exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=finance-dashboard --branch=main

_notes: monorepo with worker (Cloudflare Workers + Hono) and web (React + Vite). e2e (`pnpm --filter web e2e`) hits production and is excluded from default test command.
